chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him): When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) died, 'Abbas and Abu Sufyan addressed him regarding that he should pay allegiance to him for the Caliphate (and this was after the allegiance had been completed for Abu Bakr in Al-Saqifah, and therein he forbids fitnah and clarifies his character and knowledge):

key_terms.السَّقِيفَة: Al-Saqifah (the place where allegiance to Abu Bakr was sworn)

ai.seo_question: What is the historical context of Imam Ali's speech regarding the offer of Caliphate from Abbas and Abu Sufyan?
ai.summary: This header introduces Imam Ali’s discourse following the Saqifah event, where the Hashemite patriarchs sought to consolidate his authority against the emerging Umayyad and Banu Abd Shams influence. It underscores the critical Shia perspective that Ali’s claim was not merely political but rooted in his unique spiritual knowledge (‘ilm) and moral character, positioning him as the natural successor to prevent the fitnah (strife) that would later divide the Muslim community.
